SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date... August 24, 1934.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D. 2554/17 Date 24/8/34）

Subject (in full) Release of convict Yang Nyi Chuin Tsz (楊二春子) who was arrested by the Municipal Police outside the He Zung Li (協仁里), Yangtsepoo Road, on 24.1.33.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名] D.I.

Yang Nyi Chuin Tsz (楊二春子) who was arrested by the Shanghai Municipal Police in company with one Zien Kyung San (錢景山) on a charge of propagating communism outside the He Zung Li (協仁里), Yangtsepoo Road, at 5.45 p.m. January 24, 1933 and who was sentenced to 18 months imprisonment on February 20, 1933, was discharged from gaol through the Shanghai Special District Court at 8.40 a.m. on August 23, 1934.

After leaving the court precincts Yang Nyi Chuin Tsz was met by an elderly male Chinese. They both proceeded on foot to Chekiang Road near Chefoo Road where they boarded a tram and travelled to Muirhead Road. Here they changed to another tram and travelled to Glen Road where they alighted. Yang then called at Yangtsepoo Station for certain clothing left behind by him while the elderly individual remained outside. Some 15 minutes later he rejoined his companion following which they walked to a straw hut situate on the west side next to House No. 491 Chaoyang Road. He was not seen to leave the premises until 11.40 a.m. when the watch was withdrawn.

The description of the elderly individual is as follows:-
Age about 50, height 5'4", slim build, dark complexion, short cropped hair, wearing short moustach, blue cotton jacket and pants and old brown leather shoes. Spoke Kompo dialect.

Discreet enquiries show that the elderly Chinese who accompanied Yang is his father who is a food hawker and is living in the aforesaid straw hut.

Particulars regarding the release of this convict have been recorded for future reference.

（批：FILE 3/7）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.2，特别股。
报告
日期……1934年8月24日。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别股登记室。档案号 D. 2554/17 日期 34年8月24日）

事由（全称）：释放罪犯杨二春子（Yang Nyi Chuin Tsz），该犯于1933年1月24日在杨树浦路协仁里（He Zung Li）外被工部局警务处逮捕。
由 警探长 顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）呈报 经由 [签名] 警探长 转呈

杨二春子（Yang Nyi Chuin Tsz）与钱景山（Zien Kyung San）一人同行，于1933年1月24日下午5时45分在杨树浦路协仁里（He Zung Li）外因散布共产主义罪名被上海公共租界工部局警务处逮捕，并于1933年2月20日被判处监禁18个月。该犯于1934年8月23日上午8时40分经上海特区法院获释出狱。

离开法院区域后，杨二春子遇到一名中国老年男子。两人步行至芝罘路附近的浙江路，在此搭乘电车前往穆尔黑德路（Muirhead Road）。随后他们换乘另一辆电车前往格伦路（Glen Road）并下车。之后，杨前往杨树浦站取回此前留存的某些衣物，而那名老年男子则留在外面等候。约15分钟后，他重新与同伴会合，接着两人步行至朝阳路491号旁西侧的一间草棚。直至上午11时40分监视撤除前，未见其离开该处。

该老年男子的体貌特征如下：
年龄约50岁，身高5英尺4英寸，身材瘦削，肤色黝黑，短发，留有短须，身穿蓝色棉布夹克和裤子，脚穿旧棕色皮鞋。讲宁波话。

经秘密查访显示，陪同杨某的中国老年男子系其父亲，职业为食品小贩，居住于上述草棚内。

关于此名罪犯获释的详情已记录在案，以备日后查考。

（批注：归档 3/7）
